_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne Kadi {player_id} a cikin Tic Tac Toe na uku.
Alama ka shi '{symbol}'.
Kai ka ci gaba da kadi alama shi a kasa 5x5 don kirkiri layi na huɗu.
Layoyi zana iya zama na yashi, tsaki, ko diagonal.
Gabatar da kadi ka shi da tsarin '[4]' don marka selka 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin kadi batu. Amfani da '[cell]' inda selka shi 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Selka mara batu: {cell}. Ina kamata tsakanin 0 da {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Kadi {player_id} ina kadi alama shi ({symbol}) a fidi ({row}, {col}).
